# NYC Taxi — Trip Duration Analysis

```{tags} reference, query-template, nyctaxi
```

> [NYC Taxi](../../nyctaxi.md) benchmark · [all NYC Taxi queries](index.md)

Trip duration patterns

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    dropoff_datetime - pickup_datetime
  )) / 60 / 5) * 5 AS duration_bucket_min,
  COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
  AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance,
  AVG(total_amount) AS avg_fare
FROM trips
WHERE
  pickup_datetime >= '2019-04-14'
  AND pickup_datetime < '2019-05-14'
  AND dropoff_datetime > pickup_datetime
  AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    dropoff_datetime - pickup_datetime
  )) BETWEEN 60 AND 7200
GROUP BY
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    dropoff_datetime - pickup_datetime
  )) / 60 / 5) * 5
ORDER BY
  duration_bucket_min
```
